regime.title: EU GMP Annex 11 — computerized systems (EudraLex Volume 4)
regime.determination_by: the manufacturer, and the GMP inspectorate

source.note: health.ec.europa.eu was unreachable when this map was written; section numbers follow common citation and are unverified; requirement text is our paraphrase

preamble: Section numbering follows common citation and is unverified. The draft revision of Annex 11 is not mapped.

rows.requirement: Computerized systems are validated, and the validation is documented.
rows.mechanism: The organization validates; SecuraCV supplies the methodology and its test suites.
rows.operator_action: Validate the deployment and keep the record.

rows.requirement: Data are protected against damage, and their accessibility, readability and accuracy are checked.
rows.mechanism: Hash-chained, device-signed ledgers, checked by three independent implementations (as Part 11 row 11.10(a)-integrity).

rows.requirement: Regular backups are made and their restoration is tested.
rows.mechanism: Scheduled exports and the database backup are the deployment's.
rows.operator_action: Back up the database and the high-water mark, and test a restore.

rows.requirement: Clear printed copies of electronically stored data can be obtained.
rows.mechanism: render_human and the court kit's rendered custody record.

rows.requirement: Changes and deletions of GMP-relevant data are recorded with their reason.
rows.mechanism: The closed reason_code is bound into the break-glass request hash.

rows.requirement: Changes and deletions of GMP-relevant data are recorded with their reason.
rows.mechanism: Policy-change records carry no reason field.
rows.operator_action: Record the reason for each policy change in the change ticket.

rows.mechanism: A reviewer-signed review attestation through a tree size.

rows.requirement: Physical and logical controls restrict access to authorized persons.
rows.mechanism: Host and database access are the deployment's; there is no role model in the software.
rows.operator_action: Apply physical and logical access controls to the host and the database key.

rows.requirement: Creating, changing and withdrawing access authorizations is recorded.
rows.mechanism: Roster and threshold changes are receipted.

rows.requirement: Data entry and change records the identity of the operator, with date and time.
rows.mechanism: The named requester is bound into the request hash; the self-export operator is declared.
rows.limits: Times are 10-minute buckets; API exports name a credential class.

rows.requirement: Electronic signatures are permanently linked to their records and carry their time and date.
rows.mechanism: Per-domain signatures over entry and request hashes (as Part 11 row 11.70).

rows.requirement: Archived data are checked for accessibility, readability and integrity.
rows.mechanism: Retention and export are documented; the archive is the deployment's.
